## Purpose

This document defines the recommended structure for the HW01 main report.

Goals:

* Cover all HW01 requirements
* Keep report sections traceable to deliverables and evidence
* Include mandatory AI compliance sections
* Support PDF export and oral defense
* Keep Excel or external summaries represented in Markdown

---

## Report File Names

Recommended working files:

```text
outputs/deliverables/reports/main_report.md
outputs/deliverables/reports/main_report.pdf
```

Final package should follow:

```text
StudentID_HW01_AI_<grade>.zip
```

---

## Main Report Outline

```text
# HW01 - QA/QC Jobs, Software Defects, and Physical Product Testing

## Student Information

## Requirement 2 - 20 Software Defects 2022-2026
## Requirement 3 - Physical Product Test Design and Execution

## References
## Appendices
```

## Requirement 1 Section

Include:

* Summary of 10 job postings
* Evidence that each posting was published within 60 days of submission
* At least 3 AI/LLM/automation-AI related roles
* Dated screenshot evidence with account/login name
* Job description, required skills, and salary where available
* AI impact analysis for each posting
* Table mapping `JOB-XXX` to source and evidence IDs

Recommended table:

| Job ID | Platform | Role | Date posted | AI-related | Evidence ID | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| JOB-001 |  |  |  | yes/no | EV-XXX | DRAFT |

---

## Requirement 2 Section

Include:

* 20 public software defects from 2022-2026
* At least 5 AI/LLM related defects
* Source link for each defect
* Description, severity, consequences, and solution
* One AI bias or hallucination identified for each defect
* Table mapping `DEF-XXX` to references and AI observation IDs if applicable

Recommended table:

| Defect ID | Year | Product/System | AI-related | Severity | Source | AI issue found |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| DEF-001 | 2022 |  | yes/no |  |  |  |

---

## Requirement 3 Section

Include:

* Specific physical product profile
* Device photo with student ID card in the same frame
* Brand, model, year, and masked serial number
* 15 test cases
* At least 5 executed test cases
* At least 5 execution videos with voice narration
* At least 3 edge cases AI did not find
* Defects found during execution and GitHub issue links where applicable

Recommended table:

| TC ID | Objective | Edge case | Executed | Video evidence | Verdict |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| TC-001 |  | yes/no | yes/no | EV-XXX | PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED |

---

## AI Compliance Sections

Required sections:

* AI Audit Report summary
* AI Critique, 200-300 words
* Mandatory Disclosure paragraph
* Prompt log appendix reference
* AI02, AI03, and AI05 attachment references

---

## Appendix Plan

Recommended appendices:

| Appendix | Content |
| --- | --- |
| Appendix A | Full prompt log |
| Appendix B | AI Audit Report |
| Appendix C | AI Disclosure Form |
| Appendix D | Privacy Checklist |
| Appendix E | Evidence index |
| Appendix F | Extra screenshots or test details |

---

## Final Notes

The main report should summarize final results, not become a dumping ground for raw evidence. Put large screenshots, prompt transcripts, and supporting files in appendices or evidence folders, then reference them from the report.
